subject: System Design
title: DDoS Attacks Explained
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: DDoS Attacks Explained.

hook.text: Millions of fake requests flood a server until it can't respond to real users. That's a DDoS attack.

buildup.text: Distributed Denial of Service attacks use botnets — thousands of compromised devices — to overwhelm targets.

discovery.text: Volumetric attacks flood bandwidth. Application-layer attacks target expensive operations like login or search.

twist.text: The largest DDoS attacks now exceed 3 Tbps. No single server or network can absorb that much traffic.

climax.text: DDoS mitigation services like Cloudflare and Akamai absorb attack traffic across global networks.

punchline.text: DDoS overwhelms with fake traffic; mitigation absorbs it.

quiz.question: What is a DDoS attack?
options: Overwhelming a server with fake traffic from many sources
Injecting malicious code into a website
